purpose: CC0 core set for the Nyaagyu Estate (Arena 0) and campaign chapters 1-2: backlog items 3-7 of docs/art-research/free-asset-acquisition-plan.md, plus a small extension (priority 8) of plan-named chapter 1-2 items.
credit: Powered by Poly Haven - https://polyhaven.com (assets CC0 1.0; credit kept as the API-terms courtesy)

format_policy.texture: Diffuse as sRGB JPG; nor_dx and arm as half-float EXR (DWAA). The 16-bit PNGs are about 4x larger (plan F7 and the 2026-09-25 file listing); UE imports the EXR and must set Normalmap/Masks compression. No displacement unless Nanite displacement or Mesh Terrain adopts it.
format_policy.hdri: Radiance .hdr (4K for lighting HDRIs, 2K for look-reference only).
format_policy.model: glTF 2K bundle exactly as listed by the API (gltf + bin + its textures), plus nor_dx EXR where extra_channels asks for it.
format_policy.resolution: 2K default; 4K only for hero surfaces seen from under 2 m (story bible 1024 px/m hero density: a 4K tile covers about 4 m, a 2K tile about 2 m). No 8K/16K.
